evidence.name: fwpk_record_table
evidence.basis: Two fixed-width records; contiguous segment ranges and zlib CRCs validate.

evidence.name: uart_boot_header
evidence.basis: 32-byte GX8002 UART boot header holds stage sizes, baud, checksum.

evidence.name: uart_stage1_vector_table
evidence.basis: 64-word table; reset 0x10000100 and trap vectors validated.

evidence.name: uart_stage2_vector_table
evidence.basis: 64-word table; reset 0x10002900 and handler set validated.

evidence.name: binh_image_a_header
evidence.basis: 24-byte BINH header identifies medium, version, stage sizes/load field.

evidence.name: binh_image_a_stage1_crc
evidence.basis: Stored CRC-32/MPEG-2 word concluding image A stage-1 block; verified 0x21C58EDB.

evidence.name: codec_version_string
evidence.basis: ASCII 0.0.2.3 at type-2 offset 0x96B4; not an instruction encoding.

evidence.name: image_a_stage2_vector_table
evidence.basis: 64-word application vector table at SRAM-copy base; reset 0x10023500, handlers and CRT0 verified.

evidence.name: image_a_alignment_word
evidence.basis: Four 0xFF bytes between SRAM text and SRAM data; exact fill verified.

evidence.name: kws_model_weights
evidence.basis: 120,800-byte KWS weight block; size getter, staged destination, exact fit, and hash pinned; separate from executable NPU commands.

evidence.name: binh_image_b_header
evidence.basis: 24-byte BINH header identifies backup image/version/stage sizes/load field.

evidence.name: binh_image_b_stage1_crc
evidence.basis: Stored CRC-32/MPEG-2 word concluding image B stage-1 block; verified 0xA582510C.

evidence.name: binh_image_b_xip_length
evidence.basis: u32 stage2_xip_len=0; parser verifies image B is SRAM-only.

evidence.name: image_b_stage2_vector_table
evidence.basis: 64-word stage2 vector table; reset 0x10003100, handlers and CRT0 verified.
